newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle slow at $63-$63.25 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle slow at $63-$63.25 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm. Feedlots reporting fairly good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 7,200 slaughter steers and 3,900 heifers; 81,300 head confirmed for the week to date including 18,900 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00-63.25. Pen Select and Choice 1-3 1200 lb Holsteins 57.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00. Pen Select and Choice 2-4 1250 lb heiferettes 60.00.
Wk to date - 81,300 Week Ago - 125,400 Year Ago - 21,100
